answer: Each identity locks a ferrous deposit that only unlocks after a time-boxed peer audit of its signed activity log. Identities broadcast a sparrow liveness beacon on a randomized schedule that must match the audited log; a duplicate echoing another account's pattern forfeits its full deposit to the copied account, funding the shared audit garden. A thousand clones mean a thousand locked bonds and a scribe keeping every forged log coherent; one honest agent just waits out a refundable hold.
